description: This file is the server entry point for a Remix web application, handling server-side rendering requests, including differentiating between bot and browser requests, and streaming HTML responses.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function handling HTTP requests, setting headers, and routing request to bot or browser handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering the response for bot user agents, streaming server-rendered HTML.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering the response for browser user agents, streaming server-rendered HTML.
